scope: Focused DOM identifier audit of closed S01–S10 JSON; no source mutation
rules: Only explicit class/cls/id/data-* fields, mutation old/valueAtDelivery with matching attribute name, and quoted attributes within html/innerHTML/outerHTML fields
Case-insensitive feishu match in attribute name or value
URLs and user text are not renamed; private clipboard payload and business protocol are not considered trusted merely from this scan
Repeated copies of the same attribute/value within one file are counted once; original full JSON pointer retained
Raw closed source dictionaries are recursively inspected as stored; this does not claim a general parser for every opaque payload or embedded script

candidates.classification: naming overlay candidate; preserve original evidence and exclude URL/user text transformations

replicaMappings.decision: Apply only to replica DOM identifier; preserve original evidence/payload/URL/user text
replicaMappings.status: mapping verified, business implementation not changed

limits: No claim that every opaque/private payload or dynamic selector is normalized
Project output and read/write selectors still require DR-S11-001 implementation and runtime validation
scanExecutionNotes: An initial scanner attempt stopped on a non-string mutation name before producing a report
The corrected scan type-checks field names and completed all 2678 files
The failed scanner attempt is a tool/audit implementation error, not a product or evidence failure
No source was modified to make the scanner pass
replicaApplicationConstraints: Map the exact DOM role/icon value and its readers together in a later implementation
Do not globally replace Feishu names in URLs, user text or private clipboard protocols
This report is a naming overlay; closed source hashes remain authoritative
